source: 754 Two Spirits
target: 754 Duo Spiritūs

source: When the feminine silhouette emerged from the darkness, Angoulême and his companions instantly tensed up.
target: Cum figura feminina ex tenebris emersit, Angoulême et comites eius statim commoti sunt.

source: They were still unsure how to make the humanoid Sealed Artifact move towards the bed on its own; they could only hope that the bed, also a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact, would exert its allure to entice beings to lie upon it.
target: Adhuc nesciebant quomodo artificium sigillatum humanoide, a se ipso agendum, ad lectum moveretur; tantum sperabant ut lectum, qui etiam artificium sigillatum gradus I esset, suam allicitatem ostenderet ad entia ad iacendum.

source: Of course, the Eternal Blazing Sun Church wouldn’t send merely a team of highest-ranking Purifiers for a transaction involving a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact.
target: Certe, Ecclesia Solis Aeterni Incandescentis non mittebat solum turmam purificatorum summae classei ad negotium quod cum artificio sigillato gradus I attinebat.

source: Undoubtedly, a demigod was overseeing from the shadows, but in the event of an incident, how many could be saved from the clash of two Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts was an uncertainty.
target: Indubitanter, semideus ex umbris vigilabat, sed, casu eventus, quot ex concursu duorum artificiorum sigillatorum gradus I servari possent, incertum erat.

source: As soon as the somber yet serene-looking woman appeared, she moved toward the elegant, classical bed as if summoned or commanded.
target: Quam primum mulier, tristis sed serena specie, apparuit, illa se contulit ad lectum elegantem et classicum, quasi invocata vel imperata.

source: Angoulême and the others remained perfectly still, almost like statues, fearing any sudden movement might startle their target and hinder the positive development of the situation.
target: Angoulême et ceteri perfecte immobiles mansere, quasi statuae, metuentes ne repentinus motus eorum scopum perturbaret atque progressionem bonam impediret.

source: Finally, the figure in the black nun’s attire lay down on the bed.
target: Denique, figura in veste monialis nigrae, in lecto cubuit.

source: She yawned slightly, then closed her eyes, her whole being radiating profound exhaustion, as if she had spent her life’s energy.
target: Paulum suspiravit, deinde oculos clausit, totum esse eius languore profundo refulgebat, quasi vim vitae suae consumpsisset.

source: She fell asleep.
target: Dormivit.

source: Several Purifiers stepped forward, placing their differently colored leather cases on the ground.
target: Plures Purificatores processerunt et arcas coriaceas diversis coloribus in terram posuerunt.

source: They then pulled up the red flannel cloth to cover both the humanoid Sealed Artifact and the classical bed together.
target: Tum attulerunt pannum rubrum flannelum ut simul artificium sigillatum humanoidem et lectum classicum tegerent.

source: The iron-gray steam robots also set down another leather case they were carrying.
target: Automata vaporis ferri-cinereae etiam aliam arcam coriaceam, quam portabant, deiecerunt.

source: They lifted the bed and, along with the Purifiers, left the quarry at a measured pace.
target: Lectum levaverunt et, cum purificatoribus, lapicinium gradu mensurato reliquerunt.

source: Soon, only Angoulême and the nine cases on the ground behind him remained.
target: Mox tantum Angoulême et novem arcae, in terra post eum, remanserunt.

source: At the edge of the quarry, enveloped in deep darkness, a figure dressed in assassin’s garb emerged.
target: In margine lapicinii, in profunda tenebris involuta, figura induta vestimentis sicariis emersit.

source: She did not speak to Angoulême but moved past the Purifier deacon to inspect the cases one by one.
target: Non Angoulême locuta est; sed praeter diaconum purificatorum processit ut unaquaeque arcam inspiceret.

source: Eight of the cases were either filled with shimmering gold bars or packed with numerous gold coins, all quite heavy, making Franca’s gaze seem disrupted by the gleam of gold.
target: Octo arcae aut aureis laminis fulgentibus replebantur aut multiplicibus nummis aureis congestae erant; omnes gravia, ita ut aspectus Francae a splendore auri perturbatus videbatur.

source: I’ve never seen so much gold in my two lifetimes combined… shame it’s not mine, Franca thought regretfully as she stowed the gold, valued at 1.2 million verl d’or, along with the cases into her Traveler’s Bag.
target: Numquam tam multum auri in duabus vitae meis ambit numquam vidi… pudet quod non mihi pertineat, Franca, cum aurum – quod valorque 1.2 milliona “verl d’or” existimabatur – una cum arcae in sacculo Viatoris reponeret, paenite cogitavit.

source: Another case contained the main and supplementary ingredients for the Pleasure potion and two folded scrolls.
target: Alia arca continebat ingredientia principalia et supplementaria potionis Voluptatis atque duo volumina plicata.

source: After verifying everything was correct, Franca nodded to Angoulême in a cold, businesslike tone befitting their professional relationship.
target: Postquam cuncta recta esse comprobata sunt, Franca Angoulême annuit, tono frigido et negotioso, qui relationi eorum professionali convenit.

source: “You keep your promises well.”
target: “Promissa tua bene servas.”

source: “I will continue to provide you with intel.”
target: “Continuabo tibi indicia praebere.”

source: “Praise the Sun, you are the God of Deeds!” Angoulême exclaimed, spreading his arms slightly in homage, attributing all glory and success to the deity.
target: “Lauda Solem, deus operum es!” Angoulême exclamavit, bracchia leviter diffundens in honorem, omnem gloriam atque prosperitatem deo tribuens.

source: Franca then left the quarry, continuously circling around and using her Demoness powers to erase any traces, countering any potential divination or prophecy.
target: Deinde Franca lapicinium reliquit, continuo circumvolvens atque potentiam daemonissae suae ad vestigia delenda adhibens, divinationem vel vaticinium quemlibet contraria.

source: After about seven or eight minutes, she met with Lumian in a secret tunnel in Underground Trier and was transported away by teleportation.
target: Post circiter septem vel octo minuta, illa convenit cum Lumiano in tunnel secreto sub Treveris et per teleportationem translata est.

source: Inside Apartment 702 at 9 Rue Orosai.
target: Intra Apartmentum 702 in via Orosai numéro IX.

source: Franca handed over the ingredients related to the Pleasure potion along with the leather case to Jenna, while Lumian was already seated on the armchair, engrossed in a reorganized dossier of the Sealed Artifact which wasn’t written in a fixed format.
target: Franca tradidit ingredientia ad potionem Voluptatis pertinentia una cum arca coriacea Jennae, dum Lumian iam in solio bracchiali sedebat et in fasciculo reorganizato artificii sigillati, qui forma fixa non scriptus erat, occupatus erat.

source: “Number: 1-147 “Original Name: Clémence Athana.
target: “Numerus: 1-147 “Nomen Originale: Clémence Athana.

source: “This Sealed Artifact was born in a magistrate’s family in Spahm Village, Zamet region of Upper Hornacis.
target: “Haec Artificium Sigillatum in familia magistratus in vico Spahm, regione Zamet, in Hornaci Superiori nata est.

source: “She was sent to the Zamet Cloister upon reaching adulthood and, two years later, entered Suhit University to study paleobiology.
target: “Illa, cum adulescentiam attingisset, ad Zamet Cloister missa est et post biennium in Universitatem Suhit ingressa est ad paleobiologiam studendam.

source: “After graduation, she stayed on as a faculty member.
target: “Post lauream, illa ut membrum facultatis mansit.

source: “Her research in paleobiology primarily focused on tracing the remnants of mythical creatures to prove their existence.
target: “Investigatio eius in paleobiologia primario operatu versata est in vestigiis creaturarum mythicarum sequendis, ad earum existentiam demonstrandam.

source: “At the age of twenty-nine, she abruptly resigned from her academic post and returned to her native village, where she secluded herself in her room.
target: “Aetate viginti novem, illa subito munus academicum reliquit et ad vicum natale rediit, ubi se in conclavi suo reclusit.

source: “Over the next two years, her family suffered a series of misfortunes:
target: “Per duos annos sequentes, familia eius seriem calamitatum passa est:

source: “Her father, intoxicated, fell into a cesspit at night and drowned; her mother, overcome with grief, hanged herself; her siblings killed each other over inheritance disputes; and her sister, who had gone home to intervene, went missing and was never found…
target: “Pater eius, ebrius, noctu in cloacam cecidit et submersus est; mater eius, luctus oppressa, se suspinxit; fratres et sorores inter se in hereditatis contentione occiderunt; et soror, quae domum ad interveniendum redierat, evanuit et numquam reperta est…

source: “The villagers of Spahm blamed her for bringing misfortune and sought to expel her.
target: “Vicani Spahm eam culpaverunt pro calamitatibus attulitisque et eam expellere quaesiverunt.

source: “Not long after, a strange mental plague broke out in the village.
target: “Non longe post, insolitum pestis mentis in vico orta est.

source: “By the time the Purifiers realized the issue, it was beyond redemption, and they had to purify all the infected…
target: “Cum purificatores rem comprehenderunt, iam ultra redemptionem erat, et omnes infectos purgare debuerunt…

source: “Further research indicated that Clémence Athana harbored two spirits within her, with her soul appearing stitched together.
target: “Investigatio ulterius indicavit Clémence Athana duas spiritūs in se habere, cum anima eius quasi consutura appareret.

source: “It is believed that one spirit orchestrated the tragedies of her family and the village’s infection, while the other, unable to cope, became muddleheaded yet fought back instinctively, eventually going mad…
target: “Creditur unum spiritum cladem familiae eius et pestem vicani moderasse, dum alter, insufficiens ad sustinendum, in statu turbato versus sed instinctive repugnavit, denique insanivit…

source: “Additionally, she carried another kind of corruption, distinct from her abilities to manipulate minds and spirits.
target: “Praeterea, illa aliam speciem corruptionis tulerat, quae a facultatibus eius ad mentes et spiritūs regendos distincta erat.

source: “It remains unclear when this corruption first appeared, whether before her return to her hometown or after the death of her parents…
target: “Nondum clarum est, an haec corruptio primum apparuerit ante reditum ad oppidum natale eius vel post mortem parentum eius…

source: “Sealed two years and four months ago.”
target: “Sigillata abhinc biennium et quattuor menses.”

source: “She was sealed not long ago. Among all Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts, her number must be one of the latest,” Franca remarked, having appeared behind Lumian at some point, her elbows resting on the back of the armchair as she finished reading the dossier.
target: “Non multo abhinc sigillata est. Inter omnia Artificia Sigillata Gradus I, numerus eius inter novissimos esse debet,” Franca dixit, apparens post Lumian aliquando, cum cubitis in dorso solii repositis, dum dossier perlegeret.

source: Lumian chuckled softly after a pause.
target: Lumian post pauco intervallo leniter subridens risit.

source: “Perhaps one day, this will be my fate.”
target: “Fortasse aliquando hoc fatum meum erit.”

source: He could faintly sense Clémence Athana’s struggle and resistance, but she ultimately failed and became a monster.
target: Subtiliter animadverti poterat certamen et resistentiam Clémence Athanae, sed illa tandem defecit atque in monstrum versa est.

source: Franca opened her mouth, unsure of what to say.
target: Franca os aperuit, nescia quid diceret.

source: After a few seconds, she patted Lumian on the shoulder and said, “Look on the bright side, in the grand scheme of things, we’re all going to die. What matters is what we do on the path to death.”
target: Post paucas secundas, illa Lumian in humero pulsavit et dixit: “Aspice latus serenum; in universa re omnes moriemur. Quod refert, id est quid in via ad mortem faciamus.”

source: Lumian folded up the dossier, nodded solemnly, and responded, “Until death!”
target: Lumian dossier conplectit, solenniter annuit, et respondit: “Usque ad mortem!”

source: At 10 p.m., in the ancient and dilapidated palace of the Nation of the Evernight, members of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society materialized in various locations.
target: Hora decima post meridiem, in antiquo et ruentem palatio Nationis Semper Noctis, membra Societatis Investigationis Papionum Crispinorum in diversis locis apparuerunt.

source: Franca immediately spotted 007, who was wearing the lion headgear.
target: Franca statim repperit 007, qui galeam leonis gerebat.

source: She adjusted her hood and approached, asking curiously, “We’ve received our reward. What’s yours?”
target: Cucullum suum aptavit et accessit, curiosa rogans: “Praemium nostrum accepimus. Quid tuum est?”

source: “007” Angoulême replied with mixed emotions, “I can now wield a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact with less severe adverse effects.”
target: “007,” Angoulême respondit cum affectibus mixtis: “Nunc possum artificium sigillatum gradus I uti cum effectibus adversis minus gravibus.”

source: “Wow, you’re basically on reserve for demigod status!” Franca exclaimed enviously.
target: “O mirum, es re vera in reposito ad statum semidei!” Franca exclamavit invidens.

source: Her thoughts then turned to Lumian, who also possessed a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact with minor negative effects, essentially putting him in the same reserve category.
target: Deinde cogitavit de Lumiano, qui quoque artificium sigillatum gradus I cum effectibus adversis levibus posidebat, quod eum in eadem reposito categoria collocabat.

source: Before Lumian embarked on the paths of the divine, 007 had already been a Sequence 5 Beyonder.
target: Antequam Lumian itinera divina inciperet, 007 iam Sequens 5 Beyonder fuit.

source: He was just too busy to serve as vice president of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society, so he had never shared this with others.
target: Tantopere occupatus erat ut vice praesidens Societatis Investigationis Papionum Crispinorum operaretur, ideo numquam hoc aliis enuntiavit.

source: Thinking about it, 007 wasn’t really that enviable after all.
target: Ruminans, 007 non vere tam invidendus erat.

source: 007 glanced at Franca and said, “I used to dream of advancing to Sequence 4 and becoming a demigod, but as I handled more and more Beyonder events, I started to think that it might not be such a good thing. Sigh, fate has pushed me to this point; I can only keep moving forward.”
target: 007 Francam intueri et dixit: “Olim somniabam me ad Sequentiam 4 progredi et semidei fieri, sed cum plura eventa Beyonder gesserim, incipiebam credere id non tam optimum esse. Heu, fatum me ad hunc locum impulit; solum pergere possum.”

source: “Right,” Franca replied, feeling a sense of kinship. “I have a very important announcement to make soon.”
target: “Recte,” Franca respondit, affecta sensu cognationis, “mox nuntium valde grave tradere habeo.”

source: “What is it?” 007 couldn’t help but ask impulsively.
target: “Quid est?” 007 impulsive rogavit.

source: Why is Hidden Blade involved in an important matter again?
target: Cur Hidden Blade iterum in re gravissima implicatus sit?

source: What is it this time?
target: Quid est hoc tempore?

source: So far, the news she brought was crazier and more shocking one after the other!
target: Hactenus, nuntii quae attulerat, alter post alterum insaniores ac mirabiliores erant!

source: “You’ll find out soon enough.” Franca sighed.
target: “Cito satis cognosces,” Franca suspiravit.

source: She then looked towards Lumian, who was now disguised as Aurore, donning a warlock robe and a black hood, heading towards the Academy group’s gathering place.
target: Deinde aspexit ad Lumian, qui nunc sub persona Aurore, toga magica et cucullo nigro indutus, ad locum conventus Academiae dirigebat.

source: Lumian, in disguise, nodded gently at Franca.
target: Lumian, sub specie mutata, leniter Francae annuit.

source: Seeing that the members of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society had nearly all arrived, Franca walked directly to the massive stone chair.
target: Cum vidisset membra Societatis Investigationis Papionum Crispinorum paene omnes advenisse, Franca recta ad magnam sellam lapideam processit.

source: Dressed in a plain white robe and resembling a half-giant, Gandalf was nearby.
target: Vestitus in simplice veste alba et semigianti similis, Gandalf prope adfuit.

source: He whispered, “Are you going to warn everyone about the Mirror People?”
target: Submurmuravit: “Num omnes de Hominibus Speculorum moneas?”

source: “No,” Franca looked at Madame Hela standing on the other side and conjured a simple megaphone from the cold air.
target: “Non,” Franca vidit Madame Hela in altera parte stantem et ex frigida aere megaphonum simplicem conjuravit.

source: “Ladies and gentlemen, I have an announcement to make,” Franca’s voice echoed through the ancient and dilapidated palace.
target: “Dominae et domini, nuntium habere habeo,” vox Francae per palatium antiqua et dilapidata resonabat.

source: Members like Isotope, Bear, and Cerberus of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society turned their attention towards the depth of the palace to see who was speaking.
target: Membra, ut Isotope, Ursus, et Cerberus Societatis Investigationis Papionum Crispinorum, attentionem converterunt ad interiora palatii ut perspexerent quis loqueretur.

source: They suddenly felt uneasy.
target: Subito male se sentiunt.

source: The news Hidden Blade had brought before was never good!
target: Nuntii quos Hidden Blade attulerat numquam bonos erant!

source: Although she helped the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society clean up its internal saboteurs and established more reliable rules, avoiding foreseeable harm, the surging tide still left every participant unnerved.
target: Quamquam illa Societati Investigationis Papionum Crispinorum internos sabotorēs purgare et regulas firmiores constituere adiuvit, ne damna praevidenda evenirent, fluctus tamen impetuosus omnes participes perturbavit.

source: As everyone ceased their discussions and looked towards her, Franca cleared her throat and started from the rumors about Resurrection Island, recounting her encounter in the catacombs of Trier with a man bearing Eastern looks in their original world.
target: Cum omnes sermones deseruerint et ad eam spectarent, Franca guttur purgavit et ab rumoribus de Insula Resurrectionis incipiens narravit conventum suum in catacumbis Treverorum cum viro vultum orientalem in mundo suo originali gerente.

source: So, it’s about this… There’s a continuation of that incident? 007 relaxed slightly.
target: Ita, de hoc est… Continuatio illius rei est? 007 leviter relaxatus est.

source: A humming sound arose in different parts of the old palace, and members of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society couldn’t help whispering among themselves.
target: Sonus mugitus in diversis partibus veteris palatii orsus est, et membra Societatis Investigationis Papionum Crispinorum inter se susurrare non potuerunt.

source: For most of them, they had already accepted reality, adapted to their current lives, and even had different pursuits.
target: Plerorum iam veritatem susceperant, ad vitam praesentem se accommodaverant, atque etiam varia studia habebant.

source: But now, someone was telling them that the matter of transmigration still had secrets; maybe they could even go home!
target: Sed nunc, aliquis eis narrabat rem transmigrationis adhuc arcana habere; fortasse etiam domum redire possent!

source: Franca then spoke about Harrison of Resurrection Island, involved with death and dark forces, searching for something across the Northern and Southern Continents, but she didn’t mention Demon Warlock Burman—it was too easy to link that to the great adventurer Louis Berry.
target: Deinde Franca de Harrison de Insula Resurrectionis locuta est, morte et tenebris implicato, quaerens aliquid per Continenta Septentrionalia et Australia, sed Demon Warlock Burman non commemoravit—nimis facile hoc ad magnum adventorem Louis Berry coniungere.

source: In the sudden silence inside the palace, Franca shared her and Lumian’s speculation, “Resurrection Island might be a nexus where the two worlds converge.
target: In subito silentio intra palatium, Franca speculatio sua et Lumiani communicavit: “Insula Resurrectionis fortasse nexus erit ubi duo mundi conveniant.

source: “We must find Harrison and get information about Resurrection Island from him!”
target: “Harrison invenire debemus et a eo de Insula Resurrectionis notitiam adipisci!”

source: After speaking in one breath, Franca’s gaze slowly moved from the somewhat dazed faces of the audience to Madame Hela nearby.
target: Post unum suspiri sermonem, oculi Francae lente ab faciebus paulo obnubilatis audientium ad Madame Hela prope stantem migraverunt.

source: She noticed an indescribable emotion in the dark pupils visible behind Madame Hela’s black latticed veil.
target: Animadvertit in obscuris pupillis, sub velamine nigro reticulato Madame Hela, affectum inenarrabilem.
